sloka: ऊर्ध्वम् मासान् न वस्तव्यम् वसन् वध्यो भवेन् मम ।सह एव शूरो युष्माभिः श्वशुरो मे गमिष्यति ॥४-४२-५३॥
transliteration: ūrdhvam māsān na vastavyam vasan vadhyo bhaven mama ।saha eva śūro yuṣmābhiḥ śvaśuro me gamiṣyati ॥4-42-53॥

translations.english: 'If you tarry beyond a month, you will be slain. My fatherin law, the brave hero will go with your group.
